profile.name: Dista Reza

Experienced in solution architecture, technical leadership, Product Information Management (PIM), SAP technologies, Enterprise Integration, API platforms, and cloud delivery using AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. Skilled in full-stack development, DevOps, Agile methodologies, and enterprise-scale application support. Currently focused on cloud-native architectures, Generative AI, LLM integration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), automation workflows, and AI-assisted enterprise solutions.
